Name: Looking For You - Search Npc Menu
Author: HoangTuDaa18
Description:
[quote][center][b][color=#9fc5e8][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS]Overview[/font][/size][/color][/b][/center]
[/quote][b]
[font=Comic Sans MS]🔎 [color=#9fc5e8]Spend less time searching for NPCs and more time enjoying[/color] [color=#ff7700]Stardew Valley[/color]![/font]
[/b][b][color=#9fc5e8]Looking For You[/color][/b] improves the Social Menu with convenient search, relationship filters, and flexible sorting tools to help you find the characters you're looking for.
[heading][quote][center][color=#ffd966][font=Comic Sans MS]🕵🏼‍♂️Features[/font][/color][/center]
[/quote][/heading]
[list]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]NPC Search[/color][/b] — Quickly find characters by name, with support for approximate name matching when enabled.[/*]
[*][b][color=#c27ba0]🩷[/color][color=#d5a6bd]Dating Candidates[/color][/b] — Filter the list to find NPCs available for dating.[/*]
[*][color=#ff00ff][b]Special Relationships[/b] [/color]— Quickly browse NPCs with special relationship options.[/*]
[*][color=#3c78d8][b]Weekly Gift Tracker[/b] [/color]— Find NPCs who haven't received a gift from you this week.[/*]
[*][b][color=#6aa84f]Flexible Sorting[/color][/b] — Reverse the current list order with a single click.[/*]
[*][b][color=#00ffff]Smart Search Queries[/color][/b] — Search using natural queries, including friendship-related searches.[/*]
[*][b][color=#0000ff]Multilingual UI[/color][/b] — Designed to accommodate translated labels and different languages.[/*]
[*][b][color=#9900ff]Modded NPC Support[/color][/b] — Can include NPCs added by other mods when their relevant game data is available.[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54625/54625-1793003354-425050537.png[/img]
[quote][center][heading][color=#6aa84f][font=Comic Sans MS][i]🐛 Bug Reports & Troubleshooting[/i][/font][/color][/heading]
[/center]
[/quote][heading][size=3]Found a bug or something that isn't working as expected? Your feedback helps improve the mod!
Please submit bug reports through the available bug-reporting or discussion section on this mod's Nexus Mods page.
Before reporting an issue, make sure you're using the latest version of the mod and check whether the problem can be reproduced without conflicting mods.[/size]

[quote][center][color=#ff7700][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS] Installation[/font][/size][/color][/center]
[/quote][/heading]
[heading]How to Install[/heading]
[list]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Install SMAPI (version 4.0.0 or later)[/color][/b] if you haven't already.[/*]
[*][b]Download [color=#6d9eeb]Looking For You[/color][/b] and extract the downloaded ZIP file.[/*]
[*]Move the
[code]LookingForYou[/code]folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through [b]SMAPI[/b].[/*]
[/list][b]Optional:[/b]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b][/url] to configure Looking For You directly in-game.[/*]
[/list]That's it! [b]Looking For You[/b] is ready to use.
[b]Note:[/b] Make sure the folder structure looks like this:
[code]Stardew Valley/
└── Mods/
    └── LookingForYou/
        ├── assets/
        ├── i18n/
        ├── LookingForYou.dll
        ├── config.json
        └── manifest.json[/code][code]Want to check out another one of my mods? Give this one a try!
